summary: Iter99 UI Consolidation Sprint validation — all 7 frontend mandates pass. (1) Sidebar Curatorial Atlas contains EXACTLY 5 items: Inspirations, Brand Mode, Material View, Media Library, Cultural Editions — Product Gallery and Visual Archive completely removed. (2) data-testid=sidebar-nav-media-library clicks to /library and renders the Media Library page successfully (115 assets · 121 MB visible, no 404). (3) Shared atmosphere layer defined: --mood-bg=#0c0e11, --mood-atmosphere radial gradient with warm/cyan/pearl diffusions — visible on /workspace/projects, /workspace/projects/<id>, /insights, /inspirations, /inspirations/materials, /moodboards (NO pure black SaaS feel). (4) /inspirations grid now uses column-count: 6 with gap 10px at 1920px (60 items rendered as dense curatorial archive, NOT Pinterest feed). (5) /inspirations/materials mv-grid uses minmax(150px, 1fr) — at 1920px renders 11 columns of ~157px each (denser, less 'gigantismo'). (6) /moodboards atelier grid: data-testid=moodboards-atelier-grid present, eyebrow 'DESIGN JOURNEY · TAVOLO CREATIVO', H1 'Moodboards' in Playfair, 173 cards each with data-testid=moodboard-card-<id>, italian status pills visible ('COMPOSIZIONE APERTA', 'REVISIONE RICHIESTA' confirmed in DOM), generated hero composition with title overlay for cards without cover image, palette dots + material chips (e.g., 'bronze', 'glass') + 'Per · <project>' prefix for project-linked cards, 'CONTINUA LA DIREZIONE →' CTA in footer. Project-linked card 'Apartment — Stefano' verified — palette dot count 4, materials bronze/glass, status REVISIONE RICHIESTA. (7) Forbidden lexicon scan clean: NO 'Product Library', 'Asset Manager', 'Grid Manager', 'card widget', 'file browser', 'Open moodboard' anywhere in /moodboards DOM. NO enterprise jargon (task/kanban/workflow/admin/todo) on /insights or /moodboards (the single 'sprint' match was inside a seed moodboard TITLE 'TEST_UX_Sprint_FE' = test data, not UI chrome). Page errors = 0 across all navigations. Editorial italian copy on /insights still present ('Le pulsazioni dello studio', 'Pietre miliari · Pulsazioni'). Legacy /inspirations/products → /inspirations?type=product redirect still works.

issues: At viewport width 1100px the .ins-grid renders columnCount=3, but the iter99 spec stated '4 columns at 1100px-1400px'. The 6→5→3→2 column progression jumps from 6 (>=1700px) to 3 (1100px) without a 4-column intermediate breakpoint. At 720px the 2-column behaviour is correct. Verify CSS @media breakpoints in /app/frontend/src/pages/inspirations/inspirations.css if a 4-col layout was intended at small-laptop widths.

Spec said 'italic Playfair title' overlay on the hero composition. Computed font-family is Playfair Display ✓ but computed font-style is 'normal' on .mbcard__title (H3). Visually Playfair Display renders elegantly and looks italic-leaning, but if the design intent was true italic style (font-style: italic), it should be added to .mbcard__title in moodboards-atelier.css. Cosmetic only — does not affect functionality.

action_items: OPTIONAL — add a 4-column @media breakpoint to .ins-grid for 1100px-1400px range to match the iter99 spec; currently jumps from 6→3 in that range.
OPTIONAL — add font-style: italic to .mbcard__title in /app/frontend/src/pages/moodboards/moodboards-atelier.css if true italic Playfair is intended (visually elegant either way).
critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar.jsx Curatorial Atlas list is clean, matches iter99 spec exactly (5 items, Media Library → /library).

MoodboardsPage.jsx new MoodboardCard renders gracefully for both project-linked and orphan moodboards — the smart fallback (gradient hero from project palette OR neutral warm/charcoal) works as designed.
mood-atmosphere.css is correctly imported via index.css line 2 and pages opt-in via the --mood-bg / --mood-atmosphere CSS variables — solid architectural decision, avoids per-page duplication.
Legacy /inspirations/products → /inspirations?type=product redirect preserved for deep-link backward compat (good).
